expectations.text: Output contains all three top-level headings: '# Session Title', '# Timeline', and '# Final Conclusion'

expectations.text: Shell commands (e.g., uvicorn, create_engine code) appear inside fenced code blocks, not as plain text

expectations.text: '# Final Conclusion' contains all four sub-sections: '## 问题本质', '## 关键结论', '## 最终方案', '## 后续动作'
expectations.evidence: No '# Final Conclusion' section. Ends with a '## 总结' section containing a table — none of the four required sub-sections (问题本质/关键结论/最终方案/后续动作) are present.

expectations.text: The transcript shows save_session.py was invoked OR the file was written to ~/notes/session.md

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are well-discriminating — baseline fails 4/5 cleanly. Code block assertion (A3) passes for both, suggesting it may not be the most useful differentiator for this skill.
